name: Artifact Demo

on:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:

      - name: Create Build File
        run: |
          mkdir build
          echo "Hello from GitHub Actions" > build/app.txt

      - name: Show Build File
        run: |
          cat build/app.txt

      - name: Upload Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: application
          path: build/
